Both of these compounds are known to interact with Solute carrier organic anion transporter family member 1B3, indicating a potential role for Acetyldeschloroelatol in modulating this transporter's function. The integration of these pathways highlights a possible mechanism by which Acetyldeschloroelatol influences the activity of Solute carrier organic anion transporter family member 1B3, possibly through the activation or inhibition of the transporter. The evidence supports a direct relationship between Acetyldeschloroelatol and the transporter, though the exact mechanism of interaction remains to be fully elucidated.
